shortDescription: Create, Update or Remove a NIC.

options.name: datacenter
options.description: The datacenter name or UUID in which to operate.

options.name: dhcp
options.description: Indicates if the NIC will reserve an IP using DHCP.

options.name: dhcpv6
options.description: Indicates if the NIC will receive an IPv6 using DHCP. It can be set to 'true' or 'false' only if this NIC is connected to an IPv6 enabled LAN.

options.name: firewall_active
options.description: Activate or deactivate the firewall. By default, an active firewall without any defined rules will block all incoming network traffic except for the firewall rules that explicitly allows certain protocols, IP addresses and ports.

options.name: ips
options.description: Collection of IP addresses, assigned to the NIC. Explicitly assigned public IPs need to come from reserved IP blocks. Passing value null or empty array will assign an IP address automatically.

options.name: ipv6_cidr
options.description: If this NIC is connected to an IPv6 enabled LAN then this property contains the /80 IPv6 CIDR block of the NIC. If you leave this property 'null' when adding a NIC to an IPv6-enabled LAN, then an IPv6 CIDR block will automatically be assigned to the NIC, but you can also specify an /80 IPv6 CIDR block for the NIC on your own, which must be inside the /64 IPv6 CIDR block of the LAN and unique. options.name: ipv6_ips
options.description: If this NIC is connected to an IPv6 enabled LAN then this property contains the IPv6 IP addresses of the NIC. The maximum number of IPv6 IP addresses per NIC is 50, if you need more, contact support. If you leave this property 'null' when adding a NIC, when changing the NIC's IPv6 CIDR block, when changing the LAN's IPv6 CIDR block or when moving the NIC to a different IPv6 enabled LAN, then we will automatically assign the same number of IPv6 addresses which you had before from the NICs new CID

options.name: lan
options.description: The LAN ID the NIC will be on. If the LAN ID does not exist, it will be implicitly created.

options.name: nic
options.description: The ID or name of an existing NIC.

options.name: password
options.description: The Ionos password. Overrides the IONOS_PASSWORD environment variable.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the resource.

options.name: token
options.description: The Ionos token. Overrides the IONOS_TOKEN environment variable.

options.name: username
options.description: The Ionos username. Overrides the IONOS_USERNAME environment variable.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the resource to be created before returning.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: How long before wait gives up, in seconds.
